skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and interpret short-term economic fluctuations and long-term economic growth using various macroeconomic theories and models.
Evaluate the effectiveness of macroeconomic policies and shocks on economic variables in both short-term and long-term perspectives.
Develop independent research skills to enhance understanding of macroeconomic issues.
Improve the ability to critically analyze and debate macroeconomic issues and policies at national and local levels.
Collaborate effectively in group settings to solve macroeconomic problems and present findings.
Enhance skills in presenting macroeconomic knowledge through writing, discussion, and scenario management.
Proficiently use macroeconomic models to synthesize and analyze economic and policy issues.
Apply macroeconomic theories and models to solve complex economic problems.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and participate in class activities.
Maintain discipline and responsibility in completing tasks and assignments.
